purpose: Audit §52. Per-finding closure status for the Day-12 Codex audit remediation. Branch day12-audit-remediation is a REMEDIATION CANDIDATE — not merged to main/final; scientific freeze is SCIENTIFIC_FREEZE_HOLD_PENDING_H1_H2.
owner_split: H1 (Sleep seed-before-init) and H2 (respiration native rate) are Ismet's dedicated scientific-remediation branch. All rows below are Claude-owned unless marked DEFERRED_TO_ISMET_H1_H2.

findings.title: Reproduction API must be artifact-driven
findings.summary: catalog._reproducibility rebuilt with typed ReproComponent/ReproComponentStatus (PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL/UNAVAILABLE/MALFORMED). overall computed worst-of, never defaults to SCIENTIFIC_REPRODUCTION_PASS. All numbers derived from artifact; no hardcoded 50/266/114/+0.0031/zero-diff. Env scoped to RECORDED_ENVIRONMENT_MATCH_FOR_CHECKED_FIELDS.

findings.title: Engineering unknown must never become zero
findings.summary: engineering_readiness typed Quantity/QuantityStatus. Removed 48068 total fallback and two int(...,0) candidate fallbacks. Missing/null/non-numeric -> UNKNOWN(value=None); genuine present 0 stays AVAILABLE 0. Malformed artifact normalized (no uncaught TypeError).

findings.title: Retire old uncontrolled PPG headline
findings.summary: Headline marginal_result.delta is now capacity-controlled A_cap->B (~0.605 bpm, 5/5), read from ppg_dalia_capacity_control.json. Shuffled control C->B (~0.776) surfaced. Uncontrolled A->B kept only as HISTORICAL_CAPACITY_CONFOUNDED_RESULT. New ControlledComparison schema carries per-comparison operands + own stats (M15).

findings.title: Remove unsupported power guaranteed lower bound
findings.summary: Wrist sensing-electronics power renamed WRIST_SENSOR_ELECTRONICS_REFERENCE_SCENARIO_LED_EXCLUDED; is_lower_bound=False; power_semantic_class=CALCULATED_REFERENCE_SCENARIO_LED_EXCLUDED; component_value_basis=DATASHEET_TYPICAL_REFERENCE. Fixed at builder + regenerated; propagated to backend/paper/jury/traceability.

findings.title: Metric direction must be explicit
findings.summary: Contract sign_convention is now metric-specific: lower_is_better (MAE/RMSE: baseline-candidate) vs higher_is_better (macro-F1: candidate-baseline); favorable_direction_rule states NO universal implicit subtraction. UI marginal_result carries metric_directionality. decision_inputs guard + join regenerated.
findings.limitation: Contract records are all lower-is-better; higher-is-better applies to classification artifacts elsewhere (documented in scope_note).

findings.title: Unify CRLF hash semantics
findings.summary: docs/HASH_PROVENANCE_POLICY.md: binary->raw_sha256, text->canonical_text_sha256 (LF-normalized). Fixed a PRE-EXISTING red test: build_scientific_freeze_day14.py hashed 37 JSON artifacts raw-byte (CRLF-platform-dependent) -> now canonical LF, platform-stable.
findings.tests: ml/tests/test_hash_provenance_policy.py (CRLF/LF equivalence + two-impl agreement); test_day11_14_scientific_parallel freeze hashes
findings.limitation: Historical stored `sha256` fields are not renamed to typed names (would cascade the frozen provenance chain); disambiguated by the policy doc.

findings.title: Claim checker is not semantic certification
findings.summary: Checker OK renamed STRUCTURED_TRACEABILITY_AND_FORBIDDEN_PATTERN_CHECK_PASS + explicit limitation. Added mechanical source_field resolution + api_surface route validation. Fixed 12 broken traceability references (robustness/interaction/wrist-power/system-power/BOM fields, nonexistent /research/reproducibility route x3, EOG JSONPath, digital-twin route).
findings.limitation: Lexical forbidden-pattern rules can still be bypassed by paraphrase; field/route checks verify existence, not numerical correctness. General semantic verification is explicitly out of scope.

findings.title: EOG / head rate semantics
findings.summary: Data-rate budget EEG/EOG rows carry rate_class=SCIENTIFIC_MODEL_STREAM_RATE + hardware_acquisition_rate_sps=250; statement separates HARDWARE_ACQUISITION_RATE vs SCIENTIFIC_MODEL_STREAM_RATE. 100 Hz no longer implied as raw hardware acquisition.
findings.limitation: Resp native/loaded/model rate left to Ismet H2 (§28); no Resp modality in this budget.

findings.title: Comparison operand labels (B-C control display)
findings.summary: PPG comparisons now expose explicit baseline_id/candidate_id/delta_definition per ControlledComparison (semantic labels, not a blanket candidate-baseline). Breakdown color is metric-directionality-aware (M30).
findings.limitation: Structured operands were added for the PPG headline case; other breakdowns rely on per-adapter delta computation with metric_directionality rather than a per-entry operand pair.

findings.title: Cache provenance
findings.summary: ppg_dalia cache writer embeds _provenance (schema_version/subject_id/modality_config); reader rejects subject mismatch and warns LEGACY_CACHE_UNVERIFIED on legacy caches instead of silent trust. Existing caches not rebuilt (§35).
findings.limitation: PTT cache loader not yet stamped (same pattern applies); existing caches load as legacy-unverified until re-stamped.

findings.title: Predeclaration wording
findings.summary: Added evidence-basis note to SENSOR_MARGINAL_VALUE_METHODOLOGY.md: 'predeclared' rests on commit-history ancestry, not an external registry. Genuine Day-8/9 predeclarations committed before results retain stronger wording (not downgraded, per §40).
findings.limitation: Per-claim git ancestry/timing was not exhaustively forensically re-verified; the note scopes the claim rather than auditing each timestamp.

findings.title: Archive builder + reproduction CLI exit codes
findings.summary: Two verifiers that printed MISMATCH with exit 0 now exit nonzero. Checkpoint-archive builder: empty-selection/collision/missing-checkpoint/verification-mismatch/leaked-dataset -> exit 1; staging cleanup; membership completeness; refuses to overwrite historical archive without BIOMIN_ARCHIVE_OVERWRITE=1.
findings.limitation: Day-14 archive builder (build_checkpoint_archive_day14.py) not hardened in this pass; the Day-8 builder is the canonical one.

findings.title: TorchInferenceEngine / Digital Twin honesty
findings.summary: TorchInferenceEngine documented to run NO forward pass (returns mock snapshot values); name=torch_v1_mock_passthrough; runs_real_inference=False (Option B). Digital Twin page present-tense 'learns/tracks' -> 'would learn / simulated, not learned'.
findings.limitation: Real forward-pass inference is intentionally NOT implemented (would expand scope).

findings.title: Source-of-truth duplication
findings.summary: Engineering numeric burdens flow source artifact -> builder -> API (engineering_readiness reads day11_part3_engineering_inputs.json; no numeric constants duplicated in the adapter). PPG headline reads capacity_control.json live. Presentation copy strings remain in the adapter but carry no numbers that also live in an artifact.
findings.tests: existing adapter tests read live artifacts
findings.limitation: A full de-duplication audit of every hand-maintained canonical JSON (§34) was not exhaustively converted to builders; the three engineering reference JSONs are builder-generated (build_day11_part2_engineering.py). Any remaining hand-maintained narrative artifacts are historical and left as-is.

findings.title: Research load resilience (optional panel isolation)
findings.summary: researchStore.load refactored: core scientific data (experiments + summary) in try/catch; optional panels (engineering/operational/decision/topology/pareto) each settled via optional() so a 404/500/malformed on an optional endpoint cannot abort the core scientific panels.
findings.tests: tsc + frontend build; structural (no configured frontend test runner, §42)
findings.limitation: No automated frontend test runner is configured; isolation verified by types + live browser validation.

findings.title: Replication metadata matched to the correct estimate
findings.summary: Each ControlledComparison carries its OWN n_seeds/mean/SD/sign-count; no blending of a single-run magnitude with another comparison's five-seed consistency.

findings.title: Interaction metadata
findings.summary: contract.interaction_effects: interaction_evidence=partial_one_controlled_pair, controlled_pairs_tested=1, global_interaction_coverage=partial, interpretation=approximately_additive_or_unresolved. SENSOR_INTERACTION_LIMITATION.md gets a Day-10 update banner.

findings.title: Metric-specific display rules
findings.summary: Removed the single global 0.05 magnitude color threshold across bpm and macro-F1; deltaClass colors by direction only (exact 0 neutral).

findings.title: Test language (artifact-consistency vs executable-reproduction)
findings.summary: Documented the test taxonomy in docs/TEST_TAXONOMY.md: stored-JSON assertion tests are artifact-consistency tests; ml/verify_*.py + archive-guard tests are executable-reproduction tests.
findings.limitation: Existing test files were not en-masse renamed; the taxonomy doc classifies them instead.

findings.title: Stale doc cleanup
findings.summary: Interaction limitation banner (Day-10); power reference-scenario wording in paper/jury/canonical handoffs; scoped environment wording.
findings.tests: claim checker (no stale forbidden patterns on live surfaces)
findings.limitation: Doc cleanup targeted the audit-named surfaces; a full sweep of every historical doc was not performed (historical artifacts preserved and marked superseded where touched).

findings.title: Sleep seed-before-initialization reproducibility
findings.summary: Owned by Ismet's dedicated scientific-remediation branch; not touched here.
